entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Me!? The walls won't collapse when I do,[n]will they?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No one sneeze or we'll blow this house[n]down, okay?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, but uh... we ain't here to talk about[n]the modeling thing. There's something we[n]gotta ask you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is it true Madarame's plagiarizin' stuff?[n]He's abusin' people too, yeah?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Preposterous! Not only is the plagiarism[n]impossible, but abuse?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He welcomes pupils into his own home![n]This is no act of violence; it is charity!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And I'm the one residing here and[n]studying under him. I'm saying it's[n]not true, so it's beyond doubt.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You might be lyin' about it!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I had no family when Sensei took me in[n]and raised me into what you see now!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If you continue to ridicule the man I owe[n]my life to, you will rue this day!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: What's the matter? I heard you yelling.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: These people are slandering you with[n]baseless rumors!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: They must've heard some bad rumors and[n]came in worry for their friend's safety.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Well, even I doubt that a cranky old man[n]like myself could be liked by everyone.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I'm sorry to have butt in on your[n]conversation.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: However, I do have neighbors around.[n]Won't you please keep it down?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That was discourteous of me... I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I know! I think you'll be able to believe[n]in Sensei if you saw that painting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's his maiden work as well as his most[n]representative piece—it's titled "Sayuri."

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This was the painting that inspired me[n]to become an artist.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't know all this fine-art stuff, but[n]even I can tell that this is impressive...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: When I first saw you, I felt the same[n]powerful emotion as when I saw this[n]painting...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wish to pursue beauty like this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And I believe drawing you will be part[n]of that pursuit. I implore you: seriously[n]consider my offer.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm sorry that you took the time to come[n]all this way, but I must assist Sensei today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I hope that we can discuss this further[n]another time. If you'll excuse me, then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Those two... seem like nice guys,[n]don't they?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Maybe the Madarame we heard about[n]in Mementos is a different person.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, right when we thought we found[n]a new target, too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Was it picking up our conversation?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This display... it means that Madarame[n]has a Palace too, right!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "Madarame," "plagiarism"... and then[n]"shack," huh? These seem to be the[n]keywords.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real though, what the hell's goin' on!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Does an old man like him really have[n]a Palace!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We have the person's name and the[n]location.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All that's left is the "what" that Madarame[n]mistakes this shack for to enter his Palace.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean... like how Kamoshida thought[n]the school was his castle?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's try saying some things. They can be[n]random guesses.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: "Jail"! "Warehouse"! And "guidance[n]counselin' office"! Might as well add[n]"farm"!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: A building that's related to artists...[n]If we think from there, what would it be...?
entries.uk: Будівля, пов'язана з митцями...[n]Якщо йти від цього, що б це могло бути...?
